about: 10-prompt tool-use eval for the CRTDH MCP server (PLAN T-E7, pass bar 9/10). Each prompt runs as one conversation against seeded sample content. A prompt passes when every `expect` call happened with matching arguments (`args` values are substrings of the JSON-encoded argument), no `forbid` tool was called, and no write happened for read-only prompts.
